segments.title: Factor the quadratic
segments.narration: Start with x squared plus five x plus six equals zero. We want two numbers that multiply to six and add to five. Those numbers are two and three, so the quadratic factors into x plus two times x plus three.
deliveryNotes: Read equations conversationally, not character by character.

segments.title: Solve each factor
segments.narration: Now set each factor equal to zero. x plus three equals zero gives x equals negative three. x plus two equals zero gives x equals negative two.

segments.title: State the final answer
segments.narration: So the solutions are negative three and negative two.
